tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag snang ba bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shri ka la tsakra u pa dhi sha a lo ka na ma ka ri si/ bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag snang ba zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam bcas rnam pa med pa yi// kun rdzob bdag nyid zhi ba can// kun 'gro zhes bya'i rnam pa ston// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gzhan gsum de bzhin nyid// gsal bar byed pa 'dir bshad bya// rgyal bas brgya bcu'i bar dag tu// sems can kun la chos bstan te// dam pa dang po'i dpal ldan rgyud// dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la gsungs// de bsdus 'grel chen zla bzang gis// mdzad de byang phyogs shaṃ bha lar// lo gnyis nas ni lha dbang sogs// drug gi drug brgya'i bar du ni// rgyud kyi rgyal po ston mdzad de// de nas grags pas lo brgya na// rgyud kyi rgyal po bsdu bar mdzad// brgyad brgya na ni bstan pa'i dgra// kla klo'i thog ma 'byung bar bstan// me mkha' rgya mtsho rnams la ni// rab skyes stsogs byin kla klo yi// 'das lo'i grangs rnams shes phyir ro// lag pa gdengs can zla bas phri// lhag ma zla ba mig lag yod// de ltar lo ni dag pa la// rab tu skye sogs bzlas pa sbyin// zla ba'i don du nyi mas bsgyur// nag pa'i zla sogs du song bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar bzhi yis bsgyur// nam mkha' me dang zla bas bgo /rnyed pa steng gzhug zla dag 'gyur// gnas gsum bzhag pa'i dbus ma la// lag pa rtse mo can gyis bsgyur// 'og ma ros thob bar mar dbri// lhag ma mkha' sbyin bar nas cig /'og phab sbyangs pas chu srang 'gyur// steng 'og mig dang sum cu bsre// drug cu bgos lhag chu tshod yin// rnyed pa ste sbyin bdun gyi bgo /lhag ma tshes gza'i nges pa yin// zla ba dag par nyi zla bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar dus nyis bgo /lhag ma cha shas thob la lnga// bsres la steng ma gnyis bsgyur gzhug

/klu lag dgos lhag ril po'o// gnas gsum dbu mar drag pos bsgyur// 'og tu dgu mes thob la gnyis// bsres te bar sbyangs lhag ma de// mkha' dus bsgyur thob ros bsgyur thob// bar nas cig phab rims sbyangs pas// chu srang dbugs yin dbu ma la// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de// steng ma gnyis bsgyur rnyed pa gzhug /de la skar bgos lhag skar gnas// gza' la gcig dang chu tshod du// so gnyis sbyin zhing chu srang nas// bcu phri ril char gnyis dang cig /skar mar gnyis dang chu tshod du// drag po sbyin zhing chu srang nas// cig dang dbugs gsum dor byas la// zla re grub pa gsal bar 'gyur// gza' la tshes sbyin dbyug gur dbri// ring por tshes sbyin bcu bzhis bsgo// lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*// 'byung mda' 'dod zung me mig zla// phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /stong bas stong pa rnam dag cing*// bcu gsum zla ba rkang ba lnga// gnyis dang bcu gnyis phyogs yin la// bcu gcig mer ni bco lnga'o// bcu dang bzhir ni bcu dgu ste// dgu dang lnga par nyi shu gnyis// brgyad dang drug par nyi shu bzhi// bdun pa nyi shu rtsa lnga yin// rkang zin sngon mas cha shas bsgyur// dus nyis bsgos thob chu tshod yin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// sngar zin sdom pa phyis zin dbri// thob mnyam sbyin dang mi mnyam dor// tshes grangs gnas gnyis steng chus bsgyur// 'og ma nyi shu drug gis bsgyur// drug cus bgos thob steng la gzhug /de la bgos thob skar gnas gzhug /lhag ma chu tshod chu srang gzhug /nyi ma phyed ni dag pa'o// gnas gnyis cig la skar ma nas// drug dang chu tshod zhe lnga sbyang*// med na 'khor lo phyed bsres sbyang*// 'khor phyed lhag na de nyid dor// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la// chu tshod bsres la mda' yon bzlas// bgos pas thob pas rkang ba bzung*// drug bzhi zla ba phyi ma zlog

/gcig dang lnga la drug yin te// gnyis dang chu bo dag la phyogs// gsum pa drag po stong bar dag /rkang bzung sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob chu tshod de// mkha' ros bsgyur ba chu srang gzhug /thob pa chu srang lhag drug gis// bsgyur thob dbugs su shes par bya// sngar zin sdom zhing phyis zin dbri// gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du// lhor sgrod dor zhing byang bsgrod sbyin// nyi mar dus dang ro dang klu// bcu dang 'phrog bya 'phrog byed dang*// drag po phyogs dang klu dang drug /me dang nam mkha' zhes bya ba// zla phyed bcu gnyis rim pa yis// lhor bsgrod dor zhing byang bsgrod sbyin// nyi rkang rags pa'i nges pa'o// nyi skar cig la tshes grangs sbyin// 'og tu tshes la ro yis bsgyur// de la gza' yi longs spyod bsre// drug cus bgos thob skar gnas sbyang*// lhag mas chu tshod la sogs sbyang*// sbyangs pa'i lhag ma zla skar yin// nyi zla gnyis bsres sbyor ba'o// tshes la mig gis bsgyur ba la// cig phri ris bgos byed pa'o// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gsal bar byed pa las yan lag lnga bstan pas te dang po'o// ༈ //zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur// da lta'i zhag byin gnas gsum bzhag /'og mar ri mkha' ris thob pa// dbus kyi phung por bsre bar bya// de la drug cu rtsa bzhis bgo thob pas steng la dbri bar bya// de ni mi gsal nyin zhag rnams// gza' lnga spyi yi nyi ma ste// cig phri bdun gyis bgos na tshes gza' dang mnyam na dag lhag gcig phri chad na cig snon zhal gdams yin/gsal ba'i nyin zhag go /bkra shis gsal bar bya ba'i phyir// spyi nyir ri dus zla ba bsre// de la ri klu ro yis bgo /thob pa dor lhag skar mas bsgyur// ri sogs bgos thob skar ma'o// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob pa// dbyug gu'o de bzhin chu srang dbugs// rim bzhin byas pa longs spyod do// dal ba dag pa bya ba'i phyir// gnas gnyis gcig la skar ma nas// dgu dang chu tshod sum cu sbyang*// ma ldang 'khor lo bsres la sbyang*// sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre// mda' yon zlas thob dal rkang bzung*// de nyid bco brgyad ri snga rkang*// phyi ma la ni de las bzlog

/rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zla thob chu tshod de// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur las thob// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// de ltar thob pa de rnams kyis// snga rkang sdam zhing phyi zin dbri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas rnams su// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// dal ba'i longs spyod dag pa'o// dal dal gnas gnyis cig gis ni// nyi ma dag pa sbyang bar bya// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyangs lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// rgyal ba dang po gsum me mig /lnga dang drug par nyi shu cig /bco brgyad tshes dang drag po dang*// me rnams lnga rkang rim pas so// drag po so brgyad brgya bcu dang*// lnga bcu rtsa gsum phyi rkang yin// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus thob pa rkang pa'i nor// chu tshod yin te lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang drug gis ni// bsgyur bas thob pa dbugs yin no// rkang pa sngon dmar zin na sdom// phyi mar zin na dbri bar bya// skar gnas drug cus lhag gyur na// drug bcus dgos thob skar ma yin// de ltar skar ma la sogs kyis// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// mig dmar myur ba dag pa'o// phur bu spen pa nyid kyang mtshungs// de nas gza' lag gsal brjod bya// spyi yi nyi ma brgya yis bsgyur/ me dang nyi ma ri rnams dbri// ri sug ri klus bgos thob dor// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur thob skar// chu tshod chus srang dbugs rnams ni// rim bzhin byas pas longs spyod do// dal ba dag par bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma'i phyi dag gnas gnyis bgod// cig la skar mar bcu drug dang*// chu tshod nas ni sum cu sbyang*// ma ldang 'khor sre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug

/mda' yon zlas thob dal rkang bzung*// phyogs ri me'o phyi rkang bzlog /rkang zos sngon ma lhag ma bsgyur// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rim bzhin// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi rkang dbri// sngar gyi nyi ma phyed dag la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// gza' lag dal ba dag pa'o// dal dag cig gis longs spyod sbyang*// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// bcu drug lan cig tshes dang ni// bcu bzhi bcu gsum drag po ri// mda' dang nam mkha' lnga ma ste// rigs byed drag po mkha' mig dang*// nyer spyod so bzhi phyi rkang ngo*// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus bgos thob chu tshod de// chu srang dbugs kyang rim bzhin bya// sngar zin sdom zhing phyi zin dbri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// gza' lag myur ba dag pa'o// phur bu spyi yi nyi ma la// mkha' mkha' ro dang mig gis phri// so me rgya mtsho bgos thob dor// lhag mas skar mas bsgyur thob pa// skar ma'i chu tshod chu srang rnams// rim bzhin byas pas longs spyod do// gnas cig gnyis la skar ma nas// bcu gnyis sbyangs pa de nyid kyis// ma ldang 'khor bsre phye lhag dor// ma dor rim pas dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug bcus bsgyur// mda' yon bzlas thob rkang pa bzung*// 'phrog byed dgu med phyi rkang bzlog /rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// chu tshod la sogs rim pas bya// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas cig la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// phur bu dag pa dag pa'o// dal dag gnas gnyis cig gis ni// nyi ma dag pas sbyang par bya// ma ldang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// sbyangs lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// phyogs phyogs dgu brgyad drug ro dang*// lag pa zla ba'o phyi mar ni// me ro bug pa drag po dang*// bcu drug thub pa rim pas so// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug bcus thob nor chu tshod de// chu srang dbugs rnams rim bzhin bya// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi rkang phri// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// bla ma'i myur ba dag pa'o// spa sangs spyi nyir phyogs kyis bsgyur// chu gter dang ni nor gyis phri// ri dang rgyal ba mig gis bgo

/thob pa dang po dor ba'i lhag /skar mas bsgyur thob skar gnas yin// chu tshod sogs byas longs spyod do// dal ba dag par bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma phyed dang gnas gnyis dgod// cig la skar ma drug sbyang bya// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pa dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug bcus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// mda' bzung zla ba de bzlog phyi// rkang zos sngon mas lha ma bsgyur// mda' yon bzlas thob chu tshod de// chu srang dbugs rnams rim pas bya// sngar rkang sdom zhing phyi rkang dbri// sngar gyi nyi ma phyed dag la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// des ni dal ba dag pa'o// dal bdag cig gis longs spyod sbyang*// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor lhag skar gnas kyis rkang bzung*// nyi shu rtsa lnga gam gsum dang*// rgyal ba gnas gnyis nyer gnyis gnyis// bco brgyad tshes nor rtsa ba'o// dus dang mkha' me go dgu dang*// yon tan ri rnams phyi ma'o// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus dgos thob chu tshod de// chu srang dbugs dag rim pas bya// snga rkang bsdom zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// spa sangs myur ba dag pa'o// spen pa spyi yi nyi ma la// mkha' mig brgya dang rigs byed dbri// drug ro ri mkha' zla bas bgo /thob pa dang po dor ba'i lhag /skar mas bsgyur thob skar gnas so// chu tshod sogs bya longs spyod yin// de nyid gnas gnyis cig la ni// skar ma'i gnas nas bco brgyad dor// med na 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// ma dor rim pas dor rim min// dor lhag skar gnas drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon bzlas thob dal rkang bzung*// nyer gnyis tshes dus phyi rkang bzlog

/rkang zos sngon mas lhag ma bsgyur// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rims bzhin// sngar zin bsdam zhing phyi zin phri// sngar gyi longs spyod gnas de la// rim min sbyin zhing rim pas dor// dal ba dag pa'o de gnas gnyis// gcig gis nyi ma dag pa sbyang*// ma ldang 'khor bsre phyed lhag dor// dor lhag skar mas myur rkang bzung*// drug dang 'byung mda' rigs byed chu// mig dang lag pa mkha' snga rkang*// mig chu 'byung ba ro dang nor// me rnams rim pas phyi rkang ngo*// rkang zos sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur// drug cus thob pa chu tshod yin// chu srang dbugs rnams rim pas bya// snga rkang bsdam zhing phyi rkang phri// sngar gyi dal ba dag pa la// rim min dor zhing rim pas sbyin// spen pa'i myur ba dag pa'o// gza' rnams rgyu ba'i rim pa la// myur ba'i las kyis dus su ni// ma rgal ma dor myur 'gros shar// rgal la ma dor dal 'gros lho// dor la ma rgal 'khyog 'gros nub// rgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du'o// gza' lnga'i rgyu ba gsal byed yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ gza' lnga'i nges pa gsal ba ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //zla dag mig dang nyi ma bsre// de la mig gis bsgyur bar bya// zla nyir cig gnyis so sor sbyin// mkha' dus chu bos dgos thob dor// lhag ma thub pa lag pas bsgyur// mkha' dus sogs thob tshes skar gnas// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba gang*// slar thob pa ni chu tshod yin// de bzhin du ni chu srang dbugs// mun can 'das pa'i de yis ni// rgyu skar 'khor lo la sbyangs sdong*// 'khor lo phyed bsres 'jug ma'o// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ zla ba phyed pa'i sgra gcan gsal bar byed pa ste gsum pa'o/ ༈ mig dang nyi bsres zla dag la// nam mkha' me yis bsgyur byas te// da lta'i zhag byin de la ni// drug stong dgu brgyas bgos thob dor// dor rgyu med na de nyid dam// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la/

drug stong dgu brgyas bgos thob pa// sgra gcan 'das pa'i skar ma yin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu tshod yin te lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang drug gis ni// bsgyur thob dbugs su shes par bya// de yis rgyu skar sbyangs pa sdong*// rgyu skar phyed bsres 'jug ma'o// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ nyin re'i sgra gcan gsal bar byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ //srin po'i lo la srang gi khyim// 'das pa'i mtshams nas nges bzung ba// zla ba sum cu so drug la// mkha' mes bsgyur la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma mis bsgyur drug gis bgo /steng du mig gis bsgyur la sbyin/ drug cus bgos pa steng du sbyin// mjug rings 'das pa'i longs spyod dang*// nyi mar rim pa rim min gyis// sbyin dang dor bar bya ba ste// dal ba'i longs spyod dag pa'o// de nas zla ba phyed dang gnyis// rim dang rim min 'thon pa ste// byang gi phyogs su 'gro bar byed// slar yang zla ba phyed pa cig /rang gi zhing la 'jug pa'i phyir// de tshe tshes grangs gnas gsum bzhag /steng ma drug gis bsgyur bar bya// bar ma nyi shu brgyad kyis bsgyur// 'og tu mas bsgyur drug gis bgo /bar ma steng ma drug cus bgo /thob pa skar ma dang bcas pas// nyi ma dag pa'i longs spyod la// rims pas sbyin zhing rim min dor// des ni myur ba rnam par dag /yang ni nyi ma'i longs spyod pas// lhan cig chu srang phyed dang gsum// lhag par rgyu ba shes par bya// de ni nyin re'i longs spyod yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ du ba 'jug rings 'char bar byed pa'i rtsis gsal bar byed pa ste lnga pa'o// ༈ //dag pa'i lo la klu bsres la// de la bzhi brgyas bsgyur ba bya// klu dang bsres pa'i lo yis sbyang*// ri dang zla ba me yis bgo /thob pa skar ma'i gnas yin no// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la thob// chu tshod yin te bsgyur thob pa// chu srang drug gis bsgyur thob dbugs// skar gnas ris bgos lhag ma gza'// gza' la gnyis dag chu tshod du// mkha' me byin par byas pa yis// lo'am zla ba 'pho bar 'gyur// khyim gyi 'pho ba bzung ba'i phyir// lug sogs bcu gnyis rim pa ltar/

gza' la cig dang chu tshod du// ri dang 'byung ba sbyin par bya// de ni lug gi 'pho mtshams so// glang du rigs byed yon tan mda'// 'khrig pa zla ba ri dang zla// kar ka rigs byed me dang mda'// seng ge ri bong mig dang lag /bu mor rigs byed zung mig sbyin// srang du drug dang 'da' zla sbyin// sdig par zla ba ri zung ngo*// gzhur ni me dag drug dang zla// chu srin rigs byed ri dang me// bum par drug dang rigs byed do// nya la stong pa mig dang zla// byin pas nyi ma khyim rnams su// 'pho ba'i nges pa bzung ba yin// gzhan yang nyi ma'i 'pho ba ni// nyi dag skar ma drug cus bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug /mda' yon bzlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag ma sum cur bsgyur ba la// chu srang gsum gyis dgos thob gzhug mda' yon bzlas thob khyim de'i zhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur thob pa// chu tshod de bzhin chu srang dbugs// nyi ma 'pho ba'i nges pa yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ lo'i 'pho ba dang nyi ma khyim la gsal bar byed pa ste drug pa'o// ༈ //de nas lo zla zhag sogs kyis// khyim dang skar ma sbyor ba dang*// byed pa'i rim pa gsal bshad bya// rab skye 'byor pa dkar po dang*// bag yod skye dgu'i bdag lus 'gro// dpal zhal dngos po lang tsho dang*// 'dzin pa dbang phyug 'bru mang po// bag can rnams gnon mi bdag dang*// ri mo'i nyi ma nyi ma bzang*// sgrol byed sa bdag ma bzad pa// thams cad rgyal ba thams cad 'dzin// 'gal ba can dang rnam par 'gyur// bong bu dga' bo rnam par rgyal// rgyal ba 'dod pa kha ngan pa// gser 'chang rnam par thogs pa dang*// gyur pa dang ni kun khyer dang*// rgyal ba de bzhin dge byas nyid// bzang po khrod 'dzin sna tshogs gnas// rnyas pa 'du 'dzi phur pa dang*// zhi ba thun mong 'gal ba byed// yongs su rgyug pa zhes bya dang*// bag yod pa dang dga' ba'o// srin po me dang ser po dang*// dus kyi pho nya grub pa'i don// drag po blo gros ngan rnga sgra// khrag 'gro khrag gi ming dang ni// khro bo zad pa zhes bya ba// lo ni drug cu thams pa'o// rgyu skar khyim gyi 'khor lo ni// tha skar bra nye smin drug gi

/rkang pa cig ni lug gi khyim// smin drug rkang gsum snar ma dang*// mgo'i phyed ni glang zhes bya// mgo phyed lag dang nam so yi// rkang pa gsum ni 'khrig pa'o// nam so'i bzhi cha rgyal dang skag /kar ka ta zhes brjod pa yin// mchu gre sbo yi rkang pa cig /seng ge'i khyim du shes par bya// sbo yi rkang gsum me bzhi dang*// nag pa'i phyed ni bu mo yi// de'i phyed sa ri sa ga yi// bzhi gsum srang gi khyim du brjod// sa ga'i bzhi cha lha 'tshams dang*// snon ni sdig pa'i khyim zhes bya// snubs dang chu stod chu smad kyi// bzhi cha gzhu yi khyim du nges// chu smad bzhi gsum gro zhun dang*// mon gre'i phyed ni chu srin yin// de phyed mon gru khrums stod kyi// rkang pa gsum ni bum pa'o// khrums stod bzhi cha khrums smad dang*// nam gru nya yi khyim du brjod// de ltar rgyu skar nyi shu bdun// khyim ni bcu gnyis rim pas te// dpyid 'bring la sogs zla ba brjod// nyi zla dmar lag phur sangs spen// res la 'char ba'i gza' zhes bya// rnam sel dga' ba tshe ldan dang*// skal ldan mdzes pa shing du 'phel// zla bzang 'dzin pa zung rngu dang*// phol dang 'phel ba nges pa dang*// bar chad dga' byed rdo rje dang*// grub pa ltas ngan mchog can dang*// yongs 'joms zhi ba bsgrub bya dang*// sgrub byed dge ba dkar po dang*// tshangs pa dbang po rnam 'dzin te// sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun no// ba bang ba lag bkol bang dang*// to ti lang dang gar dzang dang*// bha ni dzang dang bī ṭi ste// 'di dag tshes phyed rim pa yis// dkar nag tshes las 'byung ba ste// dkar po'i tshes phyed cig 'bri ste// phyi ma'i phyed la ba bang ngo*// de bzhin kun la shes bya ste// gnyis par ba lab kol bang ngo*// gsum par to ti lang gang dzang*// bzhi par ba ni dzang bang ྴྟི// lnga par ba bang ba lab ste// drug par kol bang ti te lang*// bdun par gar rdzang ba ṇi dzang*// brgyad par bi ྴྟི ba bang nas// yang ni sngar bzhin bco lnga'i bar// nag po'i tshes gcig phyed phyed du// ba lang dang ni kol bang ngo*// yang ni brgyad par de nyid de// nag phyogs bzhi bcu'i bar du yin// de yi phyed du sa gu ni// gnam stong rkang bzhi klu zhes bya// mtshams su bcu drug pa yi cha// de ltar byed pa bcu gcig 'gyur// bcu drug pa bi ྴྟི'i cha// ki snu ghan sa zhes bya ste// mi dge gzhan dag dge bar byed// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las// lo zla skar ma'i khyim dang sbyor ba byed pa gsal bar byed pa ste bdun pa'o//

༈ //de nas nyi zla sgra gcan sogs// gza' rnams brtag pa'i longs spyod ni// lo gcig mkha' dus me yis bsgyur// gnas gnyis gnyis kyis bsgyur ba 'og /drug cu rtsa lngar chas dgos thob// steng gi phung por byin bsnan te// lhag ma drug cu yis bsgyur la// slar yang cha thob de nas 'og /lhag ma yang ni drug cus bsgyur// cha thob de nas yang ni 'og /yang ni lhag ma drug gis bsgyur// drug cu rtsa lnga'i chas dgos pa// thob pa de yang 'og tu bzhag /dbugs ril po de mi bdag po// nyin zhag dbyug gu chu srang dang*// dbugs byas de yang gnas gsum bzhag /'og tu ri mkha' ris thob pa// dbus kyi phung por byin la bsre// de nas drug cu rtsa bzhis thob// steng gi phung por dbri bar bya// 'dir ni lhag pa'i nyin zhag dang*// dbyug gur dang ni chu srang dang*// dbugs dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ste// 'dir ni 'khor lo'i longs spyod 'gyur// gang zhig nyin zhag cig

de la sum brgya drug cu rtsa lngas bgo /lhag drug bcus bsgyur skar bsgyur// de nas dbyug gu drug bcus te// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor longs spyod kyis/ thob pa'i dbyug gu nyin re re// slar yang drug cus bsgyur chu srang*// drug gis bsgyur ba dbugs su 'gyur// longs spyod 'di yi nyi skar dang*// dbyug gu la sogs rnams su sbyor/ bsgrod pa'i dang po nyin re bzhin// slar yang bsgrod 'gyur pa yi char// gsungs pa'i las rnams cho ga yis// nyi ma'i rkang ba sbyang bar bya// gzhan du byed pa'i lam gyis ni// nyi ma rtag tu dag pa med// nyi ma'i longs spyod ma dag pas// sbyor ba bkra shis la sogs pa/ nges pas mi gsal 'gyur bas 'dir// rtsa ba nyams pa'i shing bzhin no// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad bya ba// khyim gyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod ni// nyi ma'i zla cig dbyug gur bsres// sum cu yis ni shas thob pa// chu tshod yin te lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob chu srang nyid du 'gyur// zla ba'i longs spyod nyin re la// dbyug gu'i 'khor lo dbyug gu'i mthar// gang gis zos pa zla nyi ma'o// dbyug gu chu srang dbugs rnams kyis// de nas de yi dal du 'gyur// nyi ma dgu brgya drug stong rnams// sgra gcan gyi ni dkyil 'khor ro// bkra shis la sogs rab grags pa// rang rang dkyil 'khor rgyu bas so// nyin zhag cig la skar mar bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gyi ni rnam par dgos// thob pa rnams ni skar mar 'gyur// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur nas yang*// dbyug gu'i dkyil 'khor cha yis ni// thob pa chu srang de bzhin yang*// dbugs rnams dal ba cha yis ni /rgyal po gza' rnams so so rgyu// de nyid bsnan par byas pa ni// gza' yi longs spyod sbyangs pa gza'// gza' yi longs spyod ma dag na// zla ba'i cha ni 'char ba las// shes bya zla ba'i longs spyod kyis// ri mo du mar gnas pa nyid// de nas bsgrod pas nyi ma sbyong*// nyi ma yis ni zla ba sbyang*// cha cig gnas pa longs spyod do// zla bas bkra shis la sogs pa// tshes la sgra gcan zhugs pa yis// dus tshigs zad pa'i dkar nag ni// tshes dag gis ni gnyis dbus su// zla ba nyi ma sbyor 'dzin pa'o// de bzhin thams cad yongs shes bya// grub pa mtha' yi longs spyod gzhan// gzhan du bsdud pa byed la sogs// 'di ni ma dag rnam par spangs// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung pa'i rtag pa'i rtsis gsal bar byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //de nas gza' rnams dag byed pa// mgo la yang ni nyi ma yi// bsgrod pa nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib dang*// dus su 'khor ba bshad par bya// tha skar nag pa'i phyed bcas pa// mgo la mnyam pa'i ri mo ste// nag pa'i phyed nas nam gru'i bar// lhor gnas khyim ni gzhu lta bu// de bzhin tha skar la sogs rnams// byang du khyim ni pad ma 'dra// gang ldan nas ni me rlung bar// gza' rnams rgyu ba'i lam yin te// thams cad nyi ma'i rjes 'gro bar// kar ka ta yi khyim skyes pa// byang bsgrod mthar thug nam mkha' la// dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong ste// de las stong phrag bcu cig gis// dma' bar lhor bsgrod mthar thug yin// mgo lar brgyad khri lnga brgya'i tshad// steng dang 'og gi bsgrod par bshad// lho dang byang du nam mkha' la// dpag tshad bdun khri lnga stong 'gro// de phyed mgo la'i ri mo yin// brgya dang brgya bcu phyed gsum gyis// zhag la steng 'og lho byang 'gro// zhag gis stong phrag bcu cig bgos// rnyed pa nyin cig steng 'og tshad// bdun khri lnga stong zhag gis bgos// thob pa zhag cig lho byang yin// lo cig bsgrod pa gnyis yin phyir// nyin mtshan ring thung shes byas te// zhag re chu srang bzhi bzhi yis// 'phel 'grib lha chen gyis bstan pa// ke la sha yi byang du yin// rgya mtsho'i srog dang chu srang me// gangs ldan lho yi phyogs su 'gro// sham bha rgya dang li dang bod// 'phags pa'i yul rnams rim pa yis// dbugs gnyis dman par 'phel 'grib byed// dbyug gu ro dang nyi ma'i bar// mthar thug dus su shes par bya// lug dang srang du sum cur mnyam// de phyir gza' rnams nyi mas sbyong*// 'dzam gling dpyid 'bring zla ba la// shar 'tshams dpyid zla tha mas te// de 'og dbyar ra lus 'phags 'bring*// byang shar dbyar tha ston ras te// sgra mi snyan ni ston 'bring yin// nub byang ston tha rgyun rar shes// ba glang spyod du rgun 'bring yin// lho nub rgun tha dpyid ra bar// sa yi dum bu bcu gnyis su// de ltar dus ni kun du 'khor// khyim rnams bsgrod pa'i dbang gis so// lhun po g.yas nas bskor byed cing*// rang 'gros g.yon du 'gro ba'i phyir// bdun par 'char zhing nub pa yin// rtag par 'bum phrag drug tu 'khor// de phyed nyin dang mtshan mo'i cha// dus bzhi thun brgyad dus sbyor nyi// yud tsam mkha' me chu tshod dang*// chu srang dbugs dang skad cig gi

/rim pas 'jig rten rgyu bar snang*// sgra gcan ma gtogs gza' gzhan rnams// gdug pa'i sdig pa can du brjod// sgra gcan bsod nams ldan pa'i 'gros// khyim bzhin lhag par rgyu ba yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ mgo la dang nyi ma'i bgrod pa dang nyin mtshan dang gza' thams cad kyi 'khor lugs bstan pa ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //de nas nyi ma zla ba la// sgra gcan 'jug pa bshad pa bya// dus rtsig bcad pa'i dkar nag tshes// 'tshams su nges par 'dzin byed pas// nyi ma dag pa gnas gnyis bgod// gcig la sgra gcan 'das pa bsre// cig dang gdong 'jug gang mang pas// nyung gis sbyangs la lhag ma gnyis// gdong la phri zhing 'jug ma sbyin// rgyu skar rdzogs dang phyed lhag dor// lhag ma med na nges par 'dzin// gdong 'jug go bzlog 'dzin ma yin// yun dang cha ba'i nges pa ni// dbyung gur lhag ma bdun gyi bar// byung na phyogs sbyin de bas ni// mang bar gyur na lnga byin la// de yi mkha' dang dus la phri// lhag ma nyis bsgyur drug cus bgo /thob pas cha dang chu tshod shes// nyi ma'i cha ni bcu gnyis yin// zla ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod la// tshes gza'i chu tshod man chad bsre// sgra gcan dus me'i longs spyod dang*// gang mang ba la nyung gis dbri// lhag ma phyogs gsum byung gyur na// mnyam du 'grogs kyang 'dzin mi 'gyur// sum cus lhag na phyed du 'gyur// kun stong thams cad 'dzin pa ste// de ltar rim pas shes par bya// 'di gsang pa yi nges pa ni// nyi dag sgra gcan 'das pa bsre// rgyu skar rdzogs dang phyed lhag dor// lhag ma sngar dang mtshungs par 'gyur// zla ba'i cha ni bco lnga yin// phyogs ni bsgrod pa'i rim pa yis// nges par gsal bar 'gyur ba yin// kha dog gdong 'jug nag dang dmar// dus ni tshes zla'i nges pas bstan// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

nyi ma dang zla ba la sgra gcan 'jug pa gsal bar byed pa ste bcu pa'o// ༈ //tshes kyi 'pho mtshams nges pa ni// dbyar dgun mthar thug bcu dang phyed// snang mun mnyam la mda' bzhi cha// ston dpyid ra tha thub pa ste// dbyar rgun ra tha brgyad bzhi gsum// res kyi gza' yi chu tshod du// byin pa nam langs nas bzung nas// zad dus tshes 'pho nyi zla 'dzin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ tshes kyi 'pho 'tshams gsal bar byed pa ste cu gcig pa'o// ༈ //de nas byed pa 'pho ba bshad// grangs rnams kun gyi dang po la// rab skyes sogs sbyin lo dag go /nyis bsgyur dpyid 'bring la sogs bsre// gnas gnyis 'og mar gnyis kyi bsgyur// mda' ros thob pa byin zla dag /gnas gsum bar mar so yis bsgyur// 'og mar dug gis rnyed pa la// gnyis phri bar sbyangs lhag ma mkha'// byin pas bar nas cig phab sbyangs// chu srang yin no bar ma ni// drug cus dgos lhag chu tshod de// thob pa gnyis phri steng la gzhug /bdun gyis bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'// zla dag brgyad khri gnas gnyis bzhag /'og mar dus dang nyi ma yis// bgos lhag cha shas thob pa la// gnyis bsre steng ma lag bsgyur gzhug /klu lag bgos lhag ril po yin// gnas gsum bar mar drag pos bsgyur// 'og tu gsum phri dgu mes bgo /thob pas bar sbyangs lhag drug cus// bsgyur thob yang lhag drug bsgyur thob// cig phab rims sbyangs chu srang dbugs// dbus mar nyi shu rtsa lnga bsres// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de// thob pa steng mig bsgyur la gzhug /de las skar bgos lhag skar gnas// gzhan dag sngar bzhin shes par bya// zla dag chu bo drag po bsre// mig gis bsgyur la zla bar cig /nyi mar gnyis bsre mkha' dus chus// bgos thob dor zhing ma thob na// de nyid skar bsgyur snga ma bzhin// zla dag mig dang lag pa bsre// sum cus bsgyur la chu bo phri// gnas gsum 'og mar ri mkha' ris// thob pa dbus bsre re bzhis bgos// thob pas steng phri spyi nyi yin// bkra shis don du spyi nyi la// mkha' klu zla phri ri klu ros// bgos thob dor lhag snga ma bzhin// gza' lag spyi nyir brgya yis bsgyur// ri me ri ro bu ga phri// ri phug ris klus bgos thob dor// phur bu spyi yi nyi ma la// bu ga zla ba rigs byed bsre// so me rgya mtshos bgos thob dor// spa sangs spyi nyir phyogs kyis bsgyur// drug cu mkha' dang klu yis phri// ri dang rgyal ba mig bgos dor// spen pa spyi yi nyi ma la// me mda' chu bo zla ba bsre// drug ro ri mkha' bzlas thob dor// lhag ma thams cad sngar bzhin bya// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i rtsis gzhi gsal bar byed pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o//

༈ //ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// lus can rnams kyi lus la ni// ci ltar rlung gi rgyu ba yi// dus kyi 'khor lor ma tshang med// rdzogs pa'i dbu ma'i rlung rnams la// gza' rnams rkang pa 'byung bas te// gang du sgra gcan rtsa ba'i rlung*// de yi cha shas bzhi ru 'gyur// gza' lnga'i myur dang dal ba dang*// mjug rings nyi zla'i rkang pa'o// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa yi// dbu ma lo gsum phyogs gsum la// mngal gyi zla dgu'i dbyug gu bsdus// zhag dgur gyur pa de la sbyin// chu bo me dang drag po'i grangs// myur ba'i rkang pa ma lus yin// mig dmar rigs byed dus dang me// gza' lag chu bo bu ga zla// phur bu chu bo mkha' zlas te// spa sangs drug zla chu ba'i grangs// spen pa ro mdar nges pa yin// gang gis dbu ma'i lo gsum dang*// zla phyed cig bcas nor gyi bsgyur// mig dang bub pa lag pa'i grangs// gza' lnga dal ba'i rkang pa yin// mig dmar mkha' mkha' zla ba la// gza' lag mkha' dang chu bo yin// phur bu ro dang rig byed dang*// spa sangs mkha' dang lag par grags// drug nor spen pa'i rkang pa yin// de ltar dal ba'i rkang pa las// zla ba cig ni ma zos pa// bcu drug gis bsgyur cha cig bzung*// du ba 'jug rings rkang pa ste// lhag ma nyi zla rkang ba'i mthar// mun pa can gyi gzugs zhes pa// cha cig rang bzhin nyid du 'dod// de ltar dbu ma'i rkang pa rnams// rtogs shing mun pa bral gyur pas// dpag tu med pa 'char shes pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'gyur// gza' rnams stong par 'jug pa'i dus// dus bzhi'i rim pa shes byas te// stong phrag stong dang bdun brgyad dang*// stong phrag nyer brgyad rdzogs ldan no// khri phrag brgya dang nyi shu dgu /drug stong gsum ldan tshad du shes// stong phrag brgyad brgya drug cu bzhi// gnyis ldan rtsod dus de yi phyed// 'di rnams dus kyi mtha' ma ru// khyim sdod gza' rnams rgyu ba stong*// slar yang dus kyi nges pa rnams// sems can rtog pa'i dbang gis 'char// lo ni drug cu'i mthar 'phos te// zla ba so gnyis phyed bcas nas// zla lhag 'byung bas byed pa la// gnyis 'phar 'gyur te cig phri nas// zla lhag 'gru ba gsal bar 'gyur// dbugs ro chu tshod chu srang du// drug cu skar ma nyi shu bdun// sbyor ba 'phrod kyang de bzhin te// res kyi gza' la thub pa dang*// ril por nyer brgyad cha shas su// brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug ste// gza' rnams rang rang dkyil 'khor las// lhag ma med phyir de dag gis// bgo ba'i nges pa shes par bya// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

dbu ma'i dbugs la gza' rnams kyi rkang pa 'char ba rkang pa'i grangs bsdu ba dang*/ dus bzhi'i mthar gza' stong ba la 'jug pa'i tshul dang*/ byed pa mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa gsal bar byed pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// ༈ //de nas gza' rnams thams cad kyis// skyes khyim zhing dang rtsod pa dang*// stobs dang stobs min rim pa ni// gang du nyi zla 'phel 'grib kyis// g.yas g.yon bsgrod pa stobs ldan te// sgra gcan dang ni dus kyi me// rnam kun stobs dang ldan zhes brjod// mig dmar skyes khyim seng ge'i khyim// rta pa'i skar ma la skyes pa'o// zhing ni lug dang sdig pa ste// dgug dang drag po'i las la shis// gza' lag skyes khyim sdig pa ste// lha 'tshams la ni skyes pa ste// zhing ni 'khrig pa bu mo ste// rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa'o// phur bu'i skyes khyim bu mo ste// me bzhi la ni skyes pa'o// zhing ni gzhu dang nya yin te// bskrad pa'i las ni grub byed pa'o// pa sangs 'khrig pa'i khyim skyes te// lag ni skar ma yin par nges// zhing ni khyu mchog srang yin no// dbang gi las la rab tu bsngags// spen pa'i skyes khyim gzhu yin te// snubs kyi skar mar shes par bya// zhing ni chu srin bum pa ste// bsad pa'i las la rab tu bsngags// mjungs rings kar ka tar zhing ste// chu smad skye ba'i skar mar brjod// de dag rtsod par byed pa ni// mig dmar dang ni gza' lag gnyis// phur bu pa sangs de bzhin te// spen pa mjug rings phan tshun du// zhing dang khyim la rtsod par grags// gzhan du rtsod par byed ma yin// 'di dag rang rang skyes skar nas// rgyu skar dkyil 'khor phyed phyed du// dal ba'i rim dang rim min te// myur ba de las bzlog par 'gyur// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba las// gza' lag pa sangs mjug rings gsum// g.yon phyogs 'char dang nub par byed// zhi ba'i gza' rnams byang phyogs bsgrod// bkra shis phur bu spen pa gsum// g.yas kyi char 'gro drag po'i gza'// g.yas phyogs 'gro bar byed pa yin// mjug rings lus zhi sems ni drag

/phur bu sems zhi lus drag pas// ma ning rigs zhes brjod pa yin// nyi ma'i shar song myur ba ste// nub tu mthon pa 'khyog po ste// lhor ltas bum pa'i 'gros zhes bya// byang du phyogs pas mthon pa yin// gza' lag dang ni phur bu gnyis// myur ba stobs dang ldan pa yin// mig dmar mjug rings 'khyog po la// stobs che spen pa pa sangs gnyis// bul ba'i dus su stobs ldan yin// rang rang sde tshan gnas pa las// nyi ma phur bu pa ba sangs// nyin mo stobs dang ldan par 'gyur// mig dmar ra hū spen pa zla// mtshan la stobs cher ldan gyur te// nyin dang mtshan la stobs byed pa// gza' lag zhes byar yongs su grags// phur bu dang ni pa ba sangs// dkar po'i phyogs la stobs che ste// nyi ma dang ni spen pa dag /nag po'i phyogs la stobs su 'gyur// gnyis ka la ni stobs byed pa// zla ba mig dmar gza' lag go /zla ba dang ni pa ba sangs// glang sogs mo rnams stobs ldan ste// lhag ma'i gza' rnams 'pho khyim la// stobs dang ldan par brjod pa yin// tshes dang skar ma gza' rnams dang*// sbyor ba rim pas stobs ldan yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ gza' rnams kyi skyes skar dang zhing dang stobs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa ste dang po'o// ༈ //da ni dbyangs 'char bshad par bya// stong pa chen po yi ge lnga// rang bzhin 'phel ba'i yon tan dang*// ya na dhe shas bco lngar 'gyur// thig le stong pa yi ge drug /a ku ha ka nam mkha' ste// khong nas 'byung ba yon tan cig /i tsu ya sha rkan las te// byung ba rlung ste yon tan gnyis// ri ṭu ra sha spyi bo nas// me ste yon tan gsum ldan no// u pu pad+ma mchu las byung*// chu khams yon tan bzhi dang ldan// li tsu la sa so las 'byung*// sa ste yon tan lnga pa'o// a k+ṣa khong nas 'byung ba nyid// phyi nang gzhan gsum 'di la gnas// dus la 'char ba'i nges pa yin// a i ri u li rnams ni// nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ste// rab skye la sogs bcu gnyis la// lnga po 'char bas drug cu'o/

lo re la yang dbyangs lnga ni// zhag ni bdun cu gnyis la dbang*// dus dang yon tan zhag la 'char// bsgrod pa cig gis dbang du brjod// nyi ma'i zhag la dbyangs 'byung ba// dus kyi dbyangs zhes bya ba nyid/ gsal byed sde tshan rim pas yin// tshes la dbyangs 'char brjod par bya// dpyid 'bring la sogs dkar phyogs la// a i ri ū li dang ni// ā e ar o al 'phel ba// ha ya ra wa la rkyen 'gyur// tshes gcig nas ni bco lnga'i bar// mar ngo ring po de las bzlog /a sogs tshes kyi rim pa bzhin// dga' bzang rgyal stong gang pa ste// zla phyed lan gsum 'khor ba yin// skye dang gzhon nu lang tsho dang*// rgan po nub pa zhes bya dang*/ a ni li la nub pa ste// de bzhin kun la shes par bya// sgra gcan zla ba gza' lag dang*// pa sangs mjugs rings a la sogs// thung ba lnga po ring bas min// dus me nyi ma mig dmar dang*// phur bu spen pa ring po'i dbyangs// dkar nag phyogs kyi lhag pa'i lha// yud tsam dbyangs ni thung ba rnams// nyin mo ring ba mtshan mo min// chu tshod re la 'char ba ni// a ā zhes 'gyur ba drug cu// de yi rim pas tshu srang dang*// dbugs la 'char ba shes par bya// gsal byed tshes la 'char bar bya// kā khā gā ghā ngā rnams ni// i li u ri i a yis// bsgyur ba ring po sum cu ni// chu srin khyim gyi zla bar 'char// nga gha ga kha ka zhes pa// a i ri u li aṃ gis// bsgyur ba rim min sum cu ni// thung ba bum pa'i khyim la 'char// de bzhin tsā tshā dzā dzhā nyā gsum// am̐ sogs bsgyur ba nya yi khyim// nya dzha dza tsha tsa rim bzhin// a sogs bsgyur ba lugs tu'o// de ltar ṭā ṭhā ḍā ḍhā ṇā// oṃ sogs bsgyur ba glang gi khyim// ṇa dha ḍa ṭha ṭa zhes pa// a sogs rim bsgyur 'khrig pa'o// pā phā bā bhā mā rnams la/ aṃ sogs bsgyur ba kar ka ta// ma bha ba pha pa seng ger// a sogs bsgyur ba sum cu'o// de bzhin tā thā dā dha na// aṃ sogs kyis bsgyur bu mor 'char// na dha da thā tā rnams la// a sogs bsgyur rnams srang du yin// pā yā bā ṇā thā zhes pa// oṃ sogs bsgyur ba sdig pa'i khyim// ྈྐ ṇa sha pa ny+pa rnams ni// a sogs kyis bsgyur gzhu la'o// 'byung chen lnga bshad 'byung chung ni// ka tsa ṭa ta pa sa ni// sa yin kha sogs chu ru bshad// ga sogs me la gha sogs rlung*// nga sogs nam mkhar shes par bya// sgra gcan zla sogs thung ba ste// dus me nyi sogs ring por bshad// nyin cig yud tsam sum cu la// tshes la shar ba'i gsal byed de// dbyangs ni a sogs bco lngas bsgyur// nyin mo 'char ro mtshan mo ni// lā sogs ring pos bsgyur ba 'char// chu tshod re la 'char ba ni// de nyid ring thung gnyis su shes// de bzhin chu srang so sor 'gyur// dbugs la 'char ba'i rim pa ni// dbugs kyi 'pho ba zla ba mtshungs// gsal byed sum brgya drug cu la// dbyangs ni ring thung sum cus bsgyur// mkha' mkha' klu dang mkha' zla'i dbugs// ring dang shin du ring pa yi// dbye bas nyi khri cig stong dang*// drug brgya'i dbugs la zhag cig 'char// gzhan yang lo brgya'i lhag ma yis// lo gsum phyogs su 'char ba bshad// thung ring shin du ring ba yi// dbye bas stong dang brgya bcu'o// k+ṣa la dbyangs ni thung ba ring*// shin du ring pos bsgyur ba ni// phyogs gsum dbyangs dang gsal byed yin// zla lhag de nyid shes par bya// gang tshe bcu drug tshes shar pa// de tshe a k+ṣa shar shes bya// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

gnyen dang bral// gzhan du phyogs dang sdug bsngal 'gyur// bsod nams gza' gnas bde tshogs 'byung*// skyes skar rtsa rgyud cig la gnas// nor rnyed shin du 'thun pa dang*// dga' bar mkhas pas shes par bya// chung ma khyo dang lhan cig tu// rtsa cig la gnas skyes pa 'chi// gzhan yang gdengs ka'i bye brag ni// smin drug la sogs re re dor// de bzhin lag sogs gsum dor ba'i// zla ba gang la song ba rtag /rtsa rgyud cig la zla ba gnas// dang por rtsod pa rgyal byed cing*// phyir rol gnas pa phyi ma rgyal// de ni nges par rgyal bar 'gyur// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las// gdengs ka'i 'khor lo gsum gsal bar byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //de nas lo bdag 'pho ba bshad// ri bong mig dang lag pa la// rab skyes la sogs 'das pa byin// mig gis phri la bdun gyis bgo /lhag ma lo'i bdag po'o// de'i 'bras bu bstan pa ni// nyi ma lor zhugs than pa che// rtsi shing ngan zhing lo nad mang*// yul 'khrug mi nad phyugs nad 'byung*// zla ba char che rtsi shing rgyas// mi phyugs bde zhing yo lang che// yul bde la lar sad phran 'byung*// bkra shis char chung rtsi shing ngan// chom rkun dmag sogs sdug bsngal sbyong*// nad dang sbrul tshogs 'tshe ba mang*// rgyal pos byams par skyong mi 'gyur// gza' lag 'char snyoms 'bru bcud sman// rgyas shing ngo mtshar sgyu ma mkhan// 'gro ba bslu zhing rgyal khrims bde// stan chos mngon shes blo ldan 'gyur// phur bu lo legs rtsi shing rgyas// mi phyugs bde zhing ya rabs dang*// rgyal po gzhir gnas 'khrug pa med// char che mchod sbyin rgyas par 'gyur// spa sangs char snyoms lo legs 'bru// rtsi thog rgyas pas dga' ston 'phel// pha rol sde 'joms bde bar 'gyur// spen pa char chung nor dang 'bru// 'phel min nad dang mu ge 'byung*// skye bo 'thun min chom rkun dang*// gnod pas sdug bsngal 'gyur bar bstan// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

lo bdag gi gza' 'char ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa gsal bar byed pa ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //de nas dpyid zla 'bring po yi// mgo lar nyi zla 'dzom pa'i tshe// nyi zla bsgrod pa'i bye brag gis// zla ba'i ra la 'thon dman 'byung*// de'i 'bras bu nges pa ni// mnyam pa shin du dge ba ste// byang phyogs 'tho bar gyur pa'i tshe// char mi 'bab cing mu ge 'byung*// lho phyogs 'tho ba char mang 'bab// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ zla ba'i ltas gsal bar byed pa ste bcu pa'o// ༈ //de nas nyi zla sgra gcan gyis// bzung ba'i 'bras bu bshad par bya// tha skar bra nye smin drug dang*// snar ma nyi zla 'dzin gyur na// rnam pa sna tshogs bad kan nad// 'khris pa dang ni rlung gyur dang*// de bzhin 'dres par gyur pa ni// gzhan yang lus can kun la 'byung*// byis pa dag ni thams cad la// rnam pa du ma'i nad rnams 'byung*// mgo dang lag dang nam so dang*// de bzhin rgyal dang skag nyid dang*// nyi ma zla ba 'di dag la// sgra gcan gyi zin snang gyur na// ga dha rgyal po gnod 'gyur zhing*// de bzhin yul gyi mi dag la'ang gnod// blon po nad 'jigs shes par bya// 'chi dang nyon mongs grong khyer 'gyur// mchu dang bre dang sbo nyid dang*// me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang*// sa ga dag ni rgyu skar gyi// de la nyi zla shar ba na// 'dzin par the tshom med 'gyur zhing*// nyi zla gnyis ni shar phyogs su// sgra gcan gyis ni 'dzin gyur na// shar phyogs mi'i bdag po dang*// lā ḍa yul gyi bdag po dang*// a ga la ga dha rgyal po// mig gi nad kyis thebs pa'am// bu rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am// de bzhin 'chi bas nyer 'jigs 'gyur// dgra rnams sdang ba'i sems ldan rnams// tshogs kyang de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur// lha 'tshams dang ni snron dag la// sgra gcan gyis zin kun la snang*// de tshe nad rnams kun du 'gro// yul mi kun la'ang nad rnams 'byung*// bsad dang 'ching dang nyon mongs dang*// gnod pa rnam pa du ma 'byung*// 'ching dang gzhan gyi dmag tshogs ni// skye bo'i gtso la de dag skye// rgyu skar snubs la gnas pa la// nyi ma dang ni zla ba dag

/ma lus nub pa ji bzhin du// nyin mtshan phyed du bzung gyur na// shar phyogs gnas pa'i rgyal po ni// sdang bas gsod par the tshom med// rang nyid 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas sam// gzhan gyis de nyid gsod par 'gyur// gla klo yi ni bdag po nyid// shar phyogs su ni gsod par byed// o ḍā'i yul gyi mi rnams dang*// de tshe rdo rje zhes dag kyang*// snad par 'gyur bar shes par bya// chu stod dang ni chu smad la// nyi ma'i dbus dang zla ba ni// dmar por 'dzin par snang gyur na// rtag tu mu ge 'byung bar 'gyur// gro zhin mon gre mon gru dang*// khrums stod dus su nyi zla bzung*// kha dog nag par snang gyur na// mya ngan chen po nyon mongs dang*// yul ni kun la mu ge dang*// rgyal po rkun ma'i 'jigs chen 'byung*// khrums smad dang ni nam gru la// zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du// shar nas sgra gcan 'dzin pa na// nub phyogs nas ni nyi ma 'dzin// ma ga dha ni mi yi bdag /sems can rgyal po'i stobs nyams par// zla phyed cig gis snang bar 'gyur// rtag tu sgra gcan 'gro ba yis// mtshan ma 'di dag bstan pa yin// zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi// phyogs ni gang nas zin gyur pa// de dang de yi phyogs dag tu// dge dang mi dge 'byung bar 'gyur// gzhan yang nyi zla gzas bzung ba'i// 'bras bu mang du gsungs mod kyi// nges med 'dir ni ma bstan to/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ nyi zla bzung ba'i 'bras bu gsal bar byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// ༈ //de nas gzhan yang gza' rnams kyi// tshe'i tha ma'i 'bras bu brjod// 'khor lo'i rtsibs ni brgyad pa la// shar nas dbang ldan mthar thug par// drug pa tshes dang nor bdag dang*// ra zla mkha' zla bcu dgu dang*// bcu gnyis zla mig rim pas bgod// nyi ma'i longs spyod lo drug ste// zla ba lo ni bco lnga'o// mig dmar lo brgyad de bzhin du// gza' lag lo ni bcu bdun yin/

/spen pa lo bcu phur bu ni// bcu dgu sgra gcan lo bcu gnyis// spa sangs lo ni nyi shu gcig /tha skar nas ni nam gru'i bar// byi zhun dang bcas nyi shu brgyad// nyi sogs phyed dang bzhi bzhi ste// so so dbang byed skar ma yin// a i ri u li nyi ma// ha ya ra ba la zla ba// nga gha ga kha ka mig dmar// nya dzha dza tsha tsa gza' lhag /ṇa dha ḍa ṭha ṭa spen pa// ma bha ba pha pa phur bu// na dha da tha ta sgra gcan// ā shaṇa ā pa spa sangs// nyi zla nam mkha' rlung dang me// chu dang sa dang ye shes kyi// rang bzhin sde tshan rnams kyang dgod*// e ar al ni dbus su bri// bzhi par dbyangs 'char rim pa bzhin// gza' rnams so so'i longs spyod la// skyes skar gang yin ngos bzung nas// brgya rtsa brgyad kyi lo bgos brtag /rim pas tha ma'i 'bras bu yin// yang na gza' rnams skyes khyim dang*// zhing la gnas tshe skyes pa'i mi// skyes skar de nas rim pa bzhin// brtags pas 'bras bu nges par 'gyur// ming yig sde tshan gang gnas dang*// skyes skar phan tshun lta ba ni// zla ba spa sangs gza' lag rnams// zhi byed nyi sogs zhi mi 'gyur// sngon du bstan bzhin shes par bya// gzhan yang 'dri ba'i tshig nyid dam// 'khor lor me tog gzhag ste dri// de'i 'bras bu gsal bar 'gyur// thog mar rang rang lo yis bsgyur// klu mkha' zla bas bgos thob pa// lo ni lhag ma gsum gyis bsgyur// sum bcu bgos thob zla ba ste// lhag ma gzhan yin de la yang*// chu tshod chu srang dbugs rim bzhin// rang rang lo bsgos gsal bar 'gyur// 'di dag lha chen drang srong dang*// gzhung gzhan rnams las grags pa yin// rgyal bas thams cad las bzhin du// 'bras bu so sor nges par gsungs// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ tshe'i tha mi 'bras bu gsal bar byed pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi// khyim gyi zla ba bshad par bya// chu srin khyim gyi tshes cig nas// ma rig pa sogs rim pas 'byung*// bum pa'i zla bar 'du byed de// nya la rnam par shes pa'o// lug la ming dang gzugs yin la// glang gi zla bar skye mched drug

/'khrig pa'i zla bar reg pa ste// kar ka ta la tshor ba'o// seng ge zla bar sred pa ste// bu mor nye bar len pa'o// srang la srid pa zhes su brjod// sdig pa'i zla bar skye ba ste// gzhu la rga shis zhes bya ba// dgun zla 'bring po la sogs pa'i// nyi ma 'pho ba'i mtshams zhugs pa// nyi khyim dang sbyang brtsis pa yin// zhag gi zla bar 'thun pa ni// gang tshe ma rig pa shar ba// dgun 'bring dkar po'i tshes cig yin// gnyis pa nas ni bcu gnyis bar// 'du byed rnam shes ming dang gzugs// skye mched drug dang reg pa dang*// tshor sred len dang srid pa dang*// skye ba rga sha'i bar du ste// bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga bar// ma rig 'du byed rnam shes yin// 'di ni chu srin khyim yin la// rim pas mi mnyam pa zhes brjod// nag phyogs ma rigs pa shar ba// bum pa'i khyim gyi tshes cig yin// tshes gnyis nas ni bcu gnyis bar// rga shi skye ba srid pa len// srid dang tshor ba reg skye mched// ming gzug rnam shes 'du byed rnams// bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga bar// skye dang srid pa len pa ste// tshes lhag shar nas sred pa yin// 'di dag nag po'i phyogs zhes bya// mnyam pa zhes bya dus sbyor yin// bum pa'i lhag ma'i zla ba ste// dkar phyogs tshes gcig 'du byed de// rten 'brel rim pas mi mnyam 'char// yang ni nag phyogs nya yi khyim// rnam par shes nas bzlog pas 'char// lhag ma dkar phyogs rim pa bzhin// de bzhin kun la shes par bya// mdor na dkar phyogs mi mnyam ste// bzlog pa nag phyogs mnyam pa yin// gzhan yang khyim gyi mnyam mi mnyam// snga mar bstan pa bzhin shes bya// bye brag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /ma rig rnam shes la sogs drug /mi mnyam pa yi yan lag go /'du byed ming gzugs la sogs drug /mnyam pa zhes bya spel mar gnas// mnyam pa rnams ni drag po yi// las rnams grub par byed pa ste// mi mnyam rnams ni zhi ba yi// las rnams 'grub par byed pa yin// mdor na sems can rtog pa bzhin// rten 'brel nges pa bstan pa yin// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

rten 'brel gyi rtsis gsal bar byed pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// ༈ //de nas rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi/ 'char ba'i nges pa brjod par bya// tshes cig shar dus tshangs ma ste// gnyis la byang du drag mo'o// gsum la shar lhor gzhon nu ma// bzhi la lho nub khyab 'jug ma// lnga la lho phyogs phag mo ste// drug la nub tu dbang mo'o// bdun la rlung du rtsa mun te// brgyad pa byang shar dpal mo che// yang ni tshes dgur shar phyogs nas// tshangs ma la sogs sngar bzhin no// mtha' ma'i tshes ni phyed phyed yin// mdor na dkar nag rim pa yis// tshes kyi dang por longs spyod la// nyin mtshan la yang longs spyod bcas// 'di ni stobs dang ldan par brjod// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ rnal 'byor ma 'char ba'i nges pa gsal bar byed pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o// ༈ //de nas gzhan yang 'bri ti dang*// drag po 'char ba'i nges pa ni// yar ngo'i tshes bzhi tshes brgyad dang*// bcu gcig nya la rim pa bzhin// shar lho nub byang rim pas 'char// mar ngo'i gsum bdun bcu pa dang*// bcu bzhi pa rnams g.yon bskor du// me dang bden bral rlung dbang ldan// tshes la 'char ba'i sgra gcan te// gzhan du sgra gcan rgyu zhes grags// zla bar 'pho ba'i drag po ni// nyi ma byang bsgrod dus su ni// chu srin bum pa'i zla gcig la// shar gyi phyogs su gnas pa ste// bum phyed nya la dbang ldan du// lug dang glang phyed byang du'o// glang phyed 'khrig par rlung du gnas// de nas nyi ma lhor bsgrod tshe// sbal pa seng ge'i phyed nub tu// seng phyed bu mor lho nub tu// srang dang sdig pa'i phyed la lhor// sdig phyed gzhu la me ru 'char// drag po gzhan dag don med ces// gsungs phyir 'dir ni ma bkod do// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ 'bri ti dang drag po 'char bar byed pa ste bco lnga pa'o//

༈ //gzhan yang klu brgyad 'char ba ni// tshes kyi gza' rnams rim pa bzhin// nyi ma mtha' yas zla ba la// nor rgyas mig dmar 'jog por dran// gza' lag stobs kyi rgyu zhes bya// phur bu pad ma spa sangs yin// pad ma chen por shes par bya// spen pa dung skyong shes par bya// spen pa'i 'tshams su ra hu dang*// rigs ldan nges par 'char bar 'gyur// nyi ma'i dbus su chu tshod gcig /zla ba'i dbus su chu srang brgyad// mig dmar thog ma'i chu srang drug /gza' lag sngon ma'i chu srang gnyis// phur bus chu srang sum cu gsum// spa sangs tha ma'i chu srang bzhi// spen pa chu tshod chu srang rnams// brgyad kyis thob ste rigs ldan de// spen pa'i tha ma chu srang bzhi// rigs ldan thams cad spangs bar bya// 'di dus dge ba'i bya ba spang*// dug za klu la gnod byed dang*// sbrul gyis so btab nges par 'chi// de phyir blo dang ldan pa yis// legs par brtags te dpyad par bya/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ res kyi gza' la klu rnams 'char ba dang ra hū dang rigs ldan 'char ba'i nges pa gsal bar byed pa ste bcu drug pa'o// ༈ //gzhan yang thun phyed sgra gcan ni// nyin cig thun chen bzhi yin te// de bzhin mtshan mo'ang bzhi yin no// nyi ma shar tshe shar phyogs nas// thun phyed dus na rlung du 'gro// thun phyed nyi mar lho phyogs rgyu// dro bar thun phye dbang ldan 'jug /thun phyed nyi mar nub phyogs 'gro// de ni nyin phyed dus yin te// de nas thun phyed shar lhor 'jug /de yi phyi mar byang du'o// dgong ja'i thun phyed lho nub tu// phyi mar shar gyi phyogs su ste/ yang ni mtshan mo'i dang po nas// snga ma bzhin du shes par bya// rtsa ba'i sgra gcan ma gtogs pa// 'di yang stobs dang ldan zhes brjod// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ rlung dmar 'char bar byed pa'i rtsis gsal bar byed pa ste bcu bdun pa'o//

༈ //de nas g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i// ming dang sa stobs rim pa ni// so sor rtsod par byed pa yi// ming gi dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams// thung dang ring dang shin du ring*// phyi ma phyir mar stobs ldan te// nyung ba stobs chung mang ba che// mnyam pa dum zhing mi mnyam pas// cung zad dum min mnyam mi mnyam// phan tshun shar bas stan mi dum// gzhan yang ming stobs bye brag ni// ming gi dbyangs ni gnyis kyis bsgyur// gsal byed bzhi yis bsgyur byas te// gcig la bsdoms la bdun gyis bgo /gnyis ka mnyam na dum pa yin// mi mnyam stobs la ltas pas shes// ming gi ye ge ji snyed pa// gcig gis cig la phri bar bya// lhag ma gang yod rgyal ba ste// ma ldang pa ni 'pham par 'gyur// lhag med mnyam pas dum par byed// ming gi dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams// so sor phya la legs par brtag /zung gis pham par shes byas te// khar yar bas ni rgyal bar ston// dbyangs dang gsal byed ji snyed pa// so sor mnyam na dum par ston// gzhan yang rgyal mtshan du sogs pa// nges pa med ces 'dir ma bstan// de nas sa stobs bye brag ni// rgyu skar 'khor lo gnas pa la// zhag cig phyogs 'tshams thams cad du// gza' skar rnams ni 'khor ba yin// nyi ma mig dmar spen pa dang// mjug rings dgra bo mthar byed pa// g.yas dang bdag gi rgyab tu gnas// zla ba gza' lag spa sangs phur// zhi ba g.yon dang mdun du yod// bdag rgyal dgra rnams choms par 'gyur// de bzhin drag po 'bri ti dang*// rnal 'byor ma dang klu rnams kun// g.yas dang rgyab tu bde ba ster// drag po g.yon dang mdun du gnas// rang gi phyogs su zhi gza' song*// de tshe rang phyogs pham par 'gyur// zhi drag phyed phyed spel mar gnas// gnyis ka nges par brlag par byed// bye brag so so'i nges pa ni// skyes skar dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams// 'char ba'i rim pas shes pa yin// de las rtsa ba'i sgra gcan gyi// nus pa gsal bar shes par bya// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun la// bcu gsum phyed dang bcas pa ni// 'di'i lus ldan g.yas phyogs 'gro// mdun du gnas na nyi zla yangs// 'dzin byed mun pa nag po can// 'jigs byed stobs dang ldan pa 'di// g.yon du sgra gcan g.yas dus me// bdag po'i lto ba'i char gnas na// sgra rnams khyab mjug stobs ldan yang*// bdag la mi gnod nges par 'joms// gal te gdong dang mjug ma ru// phan tshun 'tshogs na gnyis ltung 'gyur// du ba 'khyud dang sol ba yis// rgyu skar gsum gsum khyab pas te// rgyu skar bzhi bzhir blta bas khyab// bzhi ni lto ba'i dbus zhes bya// thad ka'i bzhi ni gnyis kas mthong*// de ni nyin mtshan bye brag las// nges par brtags te g.yul 'gyed pa// pham par gyur pa yod ma yin// drag po gza' dang klu la sogs// de dag kun las stobs ldan brjod// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/

g.yul ngo'i nges pa gsal bar byed pa ste bco brgyad pa'o// ༈ //gzhan yang rdzong gi 'khor lo ni// gru bzhi rim gsum ldan pa la// dbang ldan 'tshams nas smin drug sogs// 'tshams bzhi nang du 'jug pa ste// phyogs bzhi phyi rol thon pa yin// dkyil du drag po rnam bzhi ste// lag dang me bzhi chu stod dang*// khrums smad rnams su grags pa yin// nang gi ra bar mgo dang sbo// snubs dang khrums stod 'tshams su dgod// nam so nag pa chu smad dang*// nam gru rnams ni phyogs su bgod// ra ba bar ma snar ma dang*// gre dang snron dang mon gre 'tshams// rgyal dang sa ri gro bzhin dang*// tha skar rnams ni phyogs su dran// ra ba phyi mar gnas pa ni// smin drug skag dang de bzhin mchu// sa ga lha 'tshams byi zhin dang*// mon gru bra nye brgyad po bgod// ra ba phyi mar nang ma la// skyes dkar dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams// gang du gnas pa brtag par bya// gal te phyi rol dmag dpon ni// ming dang yi ges skyes skar rnams// ra ba phyi mar yod pa na// bar ma la gnas stobs chung ste// nang du song na rdzong thob 'gyur// nang ma bzhi la drag gza' yod// phyi rol dmag gi don grub 'gyur// drag gza' phyir song dmag dpung rnams// pham zhing 'tshogs pa don med 'gyur// bar mar drag po'i gza' rnams gnas// phan tshun 'khrug 'gyur ring bas thob// mtshams la drag gnas 'jug ma dge /phyogs drag phyin thon dge ba yin// nang du bsod nams gza' rnams yod// drag gza' phyir song bsgrim mi dgos// rdzong bdag rnams la gnod pa med// de las bzlog na phyi rol gyi// dmag dpon nyung yang rdzong thob 'gyur// drag po phyi dang nang du song*// 'khrug pa chen po 'byung par 'gyur// zhi ba phyi nang dum bar 'gyur// bar mar 'dres na bar ma yin// 'bras bu nges par gsal bar 'gyur// zla ba gnas pa'i phyogs nas 'jug

/nyi ma phur bu spen pa gsum// lhan cig yod par 'gro mi rung*// sgra gcan 'jug pa gtso bo yin// rdzong du rdzong bdag skar ma la// ra hu song tshe brlag par 'gyur// de sogs bye brag dpag med na// dbang phyug gis bshad 'dir ma bstan// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ rdzong gi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa ste bcu dgu pa'o// ༈ //'pho ba'i rgyu skar tshes bsres la// spyod pa gza' yis legs par bsgyur// ming yig dang po'i gsal byed ni// rim pas bsres la gsum gyis bgo /de'i lhag mas dkon mod dang*// rin gyi bye brag ston par byed// zong dkon rin mang ri bong can// dbu mar brjod pa gnyis lhag pa// ma lus pa la rin med mod// zla re bzhin du brtags te smra// gzhan yang stor ba tshol ba ni// skyes bu ji snyed snang gyur pa// mi rnams rgan pa'i rim pa yis// dbyangs dang gsal byed ji snyed pa// re re bris la gsal byed sdom// gnyis kyis bsgyur la dbyangs kyis phri*// skyes bus dgos lhag rgan po nas// rim pa bzhin du gang mnyam yin// slar yang gzhan yang gsal byed rnams// rim pas bgrangs la re re phri// de la sngar gyi cho ga yis// chom rkun the tshom med par shes// gzhan yang don ni 'grub mi 'grub// snga mar 'dri tshig bzhin shes bya// gzhan yang gsal byed rim can la// skyes bu bsres la gsum gyis bgo /gcig gis don rnyed gnyis bar ma// stong na don nyams 'gyur bar bstan// de nas se ba tsag kra bshad// rang gi gong mar 'dzin pa yis// skar ma dang por bzhag pa la// mgo bor bdun phri rgyab tu bdun// snying khar bdun te rkang par bdun// rang gi skar mar gang brjod pa// mgo bo'i dbus song mchog tu dge /mgo bor gnas pa dga' bskyed cig /mchod 'gyur legs ster rjes 'dzin 'gyur// rgyab kyi skar ma la sogs ngan// ji bzhin pa yi bcu cha rnyed// gal te snying kha'i skar mar song*// bdag po'i dbang song ci bgyid byed// ji snyed rkang pa'i skar ma la// zhu ba don med nyon mongs 'gyur// mig gis mi mthong re thag chad// de ltar lha chen gyis bstan no// de nas gzhan yang skyes bu yi// mig gi bye brag shes phyir bshad// tha skar mgo dang rgyal dang ni// me bzhi lha 'tshams gro zhin dang*// nab so gang dang lhan gcig pa// de ni mig gi dge ba yin// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang*// 'gro lam brgya'i yu yang mthong*// lag dang snubs dang mon gre dang*// sa ri bre ga chu stod
